result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but a few carousel and fixed navigation elements look visually clipped or overlapping.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant list content. The second restaurant card is partially hidden behind the nav bar, making the image/card feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so the final visible cards are not covered by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category chips are clipped on the right edge, showing only part of the next empty-looking pill. This looks unfinished rather than clearly scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Either add a fade/scroll affordance, ensure the next chip contains visible text, or adjust spacing so partial chips do not appear awkwardly cropped.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the third restaurant card heavily cut off on the right, including its title. While this may indicate horizontal scrolling, it visually feels cramped.
issues.suggestion: Use carousel snapping, slightly reduce card widths, or add a clearer horizontal scroll treatment so partial cards look intentional.
